message.content: Let me look at the FOR_EACH_REQUEST_METHOD macro:

content:
Here's the result of running `cat -n` on /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/lwan/src/lib/lwan.h:
   220	#define FOR_EACH_REQUEST_METHOD(X)                                             \
   221	    X(GET, get, (1 << 0), MULTICHAR_CONSTANT('G', 'E', 'T', ' '))              \
   222	    X(POST, post, (1 << 1), MULTICHAR_CONSTANT('P', 'O', 'S', 'T'))            \
   223	    X(HEAD, head, (1 << 0 | 1 << 1), MULTICHAR_CONSTANT('H', 'E', 'A', 'D'))   \
   224	    X(OPTIONS, options, (1 << 2), MULTICHAR_CONSTANT('O', 'P', 'T', 'I'))      \
   225	    X(DELETE, delete, (1 << 2 | 1 << 0), MULTICHAR_CONSTANT('D', 'E', 'L', 'E'))
   226	
   227	#define SELECT_MASK(upper, lower, mask, constant) mask |
   228	#define GENERATE_ENUM_ITEM(upper, lower, mask, constant) REQUEST_METHOD_##upper = mask,
   229	
   230	enum lwan_request_flags {
   231	    REQUEST_ALL_FLAGS = -1,
   232	
   233	    /* Shift values to make easier to build flags while booting a
   234	     * request-processing coroutine.
   235	     *
   236	     * Allows this:  if (some_boolean) flags |= SOME_FLAG;
   237	     * To turn into: flags |= some_boolean << SOME_FLAG_SHIFT;
   238	     */
   239	    REQUEST_ALLOW_PROXY_REQS_SHIFT = 6,
   240	    REQUEST_ALLOW_CORS_SHIFT = 8,
   241	
   242	    REQUEST_METHOD_MASK = FOR_EACH_REQUEST_METHOD(SELECT_MASK) 0,
   243	    FOR_EACH_REQUEST_METHOD(GENERATE_ENUM_ITEM)
   244	
   245	    REQUEST_ACCEPT_DEFLATE = 1 << 3,
